 Advertisement Louisiana registration deadlines set for Dec. 12 election
 Advertisement Updated: 11:46 AM CST Nov 10, 2026 Editorial Standards ⓘ Erin Lowrey Louisiana registration deadlines set for Dec. 12 election
 Updated: 11:46 AM CST Nov 10, 2026 Editorial Standards ⓘ Erin Lowrey BATON ROUGE, La. — Louisiana voters are preparing for the December 12 election, with important deadlines for registration, early voting, and absentee ballots coming up. 
 Thursday, November 12, is the final day to register to vote in person, by mail, or at an OMV office. 
 Advertisement The deadline to register through the GeauxVote online system is November 21. 
 Early voting is scheduled from November 28 through December 5, excluding Sunday, November 29. 
 Absentee ballots can be requested until December 8 and must be submitted by December 11 at 4:30 p.m.
